page.overview:
What is Nightmare Bonnie?

Nightmare Bonnie, also referred to as The Bunny or The Rabbit in the story, appears in Dittophobia, the third and final story of Tales from the Pizzaplex #8: B7-2 as one of the secondary antagonists torturing Rory. It was built by William Afton.

When torturing Rory, Nightmare Bonnie is a large, tattered purple-blue rabbit creature, with long, mottled rabbit ears and an open-mouthed face displaying pointy teeth and pointy nails on the tips of its fingers. Once the hallucinogenic gas stops getting dispensed, the Rabbit is an oversized mechanical puppet, hung on a flimsy metallic skeleton.

In Dittophobia, Bonnie is one of the few nightmarish creatures that torture Rory every night as he breathes in hallucinogenic gas. It enters Rory's bedroom through the door on the left side of his room, slowly inching its way to his bed, eventually leaning forward, pressed against his bed, reaching out for Rory. After the gas stops getting dispensed, Rory finds Bonnie inside the left hall, revealing it to be a mechanically-controlled animatronic puppet, with tears on its fur revealing more of its flimsy, metallic skeleton that helps it move.

While Nightmare Bonnie appears to be a moving animatronic, in reality, the nightmares true forms are mounted suit parts on rolling mechanical stands to emulate animatronics hunting someone, being turned into monsters by illusions as the result of hallucinogenic gas.
